title: BirdNET Dawn-Start Shift Through Season
dataSources: Bird acoustic detections (`birdnet:detection`), wildlife-camera visits (`wildlifecam:visit`), nest-box state (`nestbox:event`), frog-call activity (`frogcall:detection`), and pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`).
app: Wildlife telemetry from BirdNET, trail and feeder cameras, nest-box sensors, frog-call detectors, and pollinator counters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, APIs, and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdnet:detection
| eval month=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m")
| eval hhmm=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H%M"))
| stats min(hhmm) as first_song_hhmm by month
| sort month
description: Tracks the first dawn BirdNET detection each month so seasonal changes in song onset become visible.
value: The dawn chorus moves with the season, and a simple first-detection trend is an engaging way to see that shift locally.
implementation: Capture timestamps for BirdNET detections from the same microphone location through the year.
visualization: Line chart of first daily song time summarized by month.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how the first bird songs of the morning start earlier or later as the seasons change.
